name: Novocaine 1g Pre-Roll
description:
Lineage: Chem Dog x Ricky Bobby

Type: Sativa-Hybrid

Terpenes:Limonene, Pinene, Caryophyllene, and Terpinolene

Aroma: Blue raspberry, pine, and earthy candy

Effects: Full-body relaxation, an amplified feeling, and a mood-enhancing, energetic, or psychedelic cerebral experience

Novocaine is a powerhouse strain designed for those seeking deep relaxation and soothing relief. Its dense, frosty buds release a rich blend of sweet berry and herbal aromas, followed by subtle notes of earth and spice. Novocaine’s potent effects settle in quickly, melting away stress and tension while leaving you in a tranquil, blissful state. Whether you’re winding down after a busy day or looking for a restful night, Novocaine delivers a premium Michigan-grown experience—smooth, effective, and unforgettable.
